scope: English and Spanish comparison guide for selected New Jersey towns with NYC transit planning relevance

methodology.selection: The town examples are an illustrative, unranked cross-section of station areas in the six New Jersey counties served by Jorge Ramirez. They were selected to explain route and due-diligence differences, not to identify a universally preferred place.
included_fields: links to the site's source-backed town guide when one exists
methodology.refresh_rule: Travelers must use official date-specific trip planning, alerts, station, parking, fare, and accessibility sources before relying on a route.
